import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Matrix {
        int h, w;
        long[] a;

        public Matrix(int n) {
            h = n;
            w = n;
            a = new long[n * n];
        }

        public Matrix(int n, int m) {
            h = n;
            w = m;
            a = new long[n * m];
        }

        public Matrix(int n, int m, long[] a) {
            h = n;
            w = m;
            this.a = a;
        }

        public long get(int r, int c) {
            return a[r * w + c];
        }

        public long get(int r, int c, int mod) {
            return (a[r * w + c] % mod + mod) % mod;
        }

        public void set(int r, int c, long v) {
            a[r * w + c] = v;
        }

        public void set(int r, int c, long v, int mod) {
            a[r * w + c] = (v % mod + mod) % mod;
        }

        public Matrix add(Matrix m) {
            assert (h == m.h && w == m.w);
            for (int i = 0; i < w * h; ++i)
                a[i] = (a[i] + m.a[i]) % mod;
            return this;
        }

        public Matrix subtract(Matrix m) {
            assert (h == m.h && w == m.w);
            for (int i = 0; i < w * h; ++i)
                a[i] = (a[i] - m.a[i] + mod) % mod;
            return this;
        }

        public Matrix multiply(Matrix m) {
            assert (w == m.h);
            Matrix ret = new Matrix(h, m.w);
            for (int i = 0; i < h; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m.w; ++j) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < w; ++k) {
                        ret.a[i * m.w + j] = (ret.a[i * m.w + j] + a[i * w + k] * m.a[k * m.w + j]) % mod;
                    }
                }
            }
            return ret;
        }

        public Matrix unit(int n) {
            Matrix ret = new Matrix(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
                ret.set(i, i, 1);
            return ret;
        }

        public Matrix matpow(int n) {
            Matrix ret = unit(h);
            while (n > 0) {
                if (n % 2 == 1)
                    ret = ret.multiply(this);
                this = this.multiply(this);
                n >>= 1;
            }
            return ret;
        }
    }

    static final int mod = 1000000007;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long k = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        Matrix[] a = new Matrix[65];
        for (int i = 0; i < 65; ++i) {
            a[i] = new Matrix(2 * k + 1);
            for (int j = 0; j < 2 * k + 1; ++j)
                a[i].set(0, j, 1);
            for (int j = 1; j < 2 * k; ++j)
                a[i].set(j + 1, j, 1);
            a[i].set(2 * k, 0, 1);
            a[i].set(2 * k, 2 * k, 1);
        }
        System.out.println(solve(n, k));
    }

    public static long solve(long n, long k) {
        long cnt = 0;
        long tmp = n;
        while (tmp > 0) {
            tmp /= k;
            ++cnt;
        }
        Matrix[] b = new Matrix[cnt + 5];
        Matrix[] c = new Matrix[cnt + 5];
        Matrix[] d = new Matrix[k + 1];
        b[0] = a[(int) k - 1];
        c[0] = b[0].matpow((int) k - 1);
        b[1] = calc((int) k - 1, (int) k);
        c[1] = b[1].matpow((int) k - 1);
        Matrix s = new Matrix(2 * k + 1).unit(2 * k + 1);
        for (int j = 2; j <= cnt + 1; ++j) {
            b[j] = calc((int) k - j % k, (int) k);
            s = s.multiply(c[j - 1]);
            b[j] = b[j].multiply(s);
            c[j] = b[j].matpow((int) k - 1);
        }
        int idx = 1;
        int rem = (int) (n % k);
        n -= rem;
        int q = 0;
        tmp = n;
        if (tmp > 0) {
            while (tmp % k == 0) {
                ++q;
                tmp /= k;
            }
        }
        q = (int) (k - q % k) % k;
        Matrix ans = new Matrix(2 * k + 1).unit(2 * k + 1);
        ans = ans.matpow(q).multiply(a[q]).multiply(a[q + (int) k]).matpow(rem);
        n /= k;
        if (n == 0)
            return (ans.get(2 * k, 0) + ans.get(0, 0)) % mod;
        --n;
        while (n > 0) {
            int t = (int) (n % k);
            if (t > 0)
                ans = ans.multiply(b[idx]);
            n /= k;
            ++idx;
        }
        ans = ans.multiply(b[1]);
        return (ans.get(2 * k, 0) + ans.get(0, 0)) % mod;
    }

    public static Matrix calc(int i, int k) {
        return a[i + k].matpow(k - i).multiply(a[i]);
    }
}
